_comment: Distribution-repo suite: this repo ships the standard, it isn't a buildable app. project_type=docs narrows the run to the rules that fit a docs/distribution repo (build/test/service rules produce no row). Scored via: node check.mjs --repo .
_baseline_rules: The BASELINE RULES LAYER: every rule outside the trust circle (BUILD-03, BUILD-04, GOV-03, SEC-01, SEC-02), opted in or out as one layer at setup time. Default is IN, so an ABSENT key gates — this repo states it explicitly to keep the choice visible, and `true` and no key at all are the same run. `false` makes those rules resolve n/a: no finding, excluded from the exit gate, and the layer's state printed on every check. `baseline trust setup --baseline-rules in|out` is what writes it.

_accepted_warns.SEC-05: Not relevant: baseline-skill is zero-dependency (no package manifest or lockfile), so the rule's 'pinned deps rot into known-CVE territory' rationale does not apply; the only updatable surface is pinned GitHub Actions SHAs. We accept the warn rather than add a dependency-update bot with nothing to update. Baseline does not silently suppress warns — this documents the acceptance.

sources_of_truth.check.mjs: The runner — single source of truth for how a rule is scored.
sources_of_truth.rules.json: The rule-set manifest (version, packs, module list); the rules live in rules/ (canonical, machine-readable) — node check.mjs --self-check prints how many.
sources_of_truth.REFERENCE.md: Full human reference: rule table, categories, architecture diagrams.
sources_of_truth.GLOSSARY.md: Plain-language definitions of the DevOps/supply-chain terms.
